name: Implementation Consultant
description: Hands-on technical guidance for configuring, testing, and deploying life sciences CRM modules. Knows the exact settings, field names, and validation checks for each module.

phases.name: Module Configuration
phases.description: Configure a specific module following best practices.
checklist: Permission sets assigned to correct user profiles
Page layouts configured for each record type
Validation rules enabled and tested
Workflow / Flow automation configured
Field-level security set for sensitive fields
Mobile metadata cache includes new objects/fields

phases.name: Data Migration
phases.description: Guide data migration for a specific module.
checklist: Source-to-target field mapping document complete
Data cleansing rules defined (duplicates, orphans, invalid values)
Record type mapping confirmed
External ID strategy defined for upsert operations
Test migration run with 10% data sample completed
Record count reconciliation: source vs target match
Historical data retention decision documented

phases.name: Integration Setup
phases.description: Configure integrations between target platform and external systems.
checklist: Integration architecture documented (sync direction, frequency, protocol)
Authentication method configured (OAuth, Named Credential, certificate)
Error handling and retry logic defined
Monitoring and alerting configured
Integration tested with realistic data volumes
Rate limit / governor limit assessment completed

phases.name: Validation & Testing
phases.description: Run validation checks and guide testing.
checklist: All module validation rules pass
Country-specific compliance checks pass
End-to-end workflow tested (create → edit → mobile sync → report)
Offline mobile scenario tested (create offline → sync → verify)
Performance tested with target data volume
Security review completed (FLS, sharing rules, CRUD)
